headline: Lighter, faster, easier to find things in
summary: RefBoard is a moodboard app again: animatics and content-aware fill are gone, images snap to each other properly, and Home gets search and renaming.

new.title: Search your boards from Home
new.description: Filter Recent Works by board name or the folder it lives in. Ctrl+F jumps to the field, and matches are highlighted on the cards.

new.title: Rename a board without leaving RefBoard
new.description: The pencil on a Home card (or F2) renames the board in place. It renames the real .refboard file on disk, keeps its backup and thumbnail, and refuses names the file system would reject.

new.title: Search a board from the toolbar
new.description: A search button sits in the left toolbar, so finding notes and images on a board no longer depends on knowing Ctrl+F.

improved.title: Images snap to each other, not to a grid
improved.description: Edge magnetism is rebuilt PureRef-style and is on by default: images butt together with no gap, edges line up down a column, and a snap holds until you clearly pull away. The dot grid is decoration only now, so it no longer quantizes every drag to 10px.

improved.title: A lighter install
improved.description: Dropping animatics and content-aware fill takes the installer from 115 MB to 86 MB, and RefBoard no longer loads a video toolchain at startup whether or not you ever used one.

improved.title: A quieter Home
improved.description: The landing page is reworked into a calmer recents workspace.

improved.title: Autosave admits when it fails
improved.description: A failed session autosave used to report success anyway. It now raises a warning that offers Save board... and names the cause, including running out of storage quota.

improved.title: Leaner undo on big boards
improved.description: Undo history is capped by memory as well as by step count, so a long session on a large board no longer holds hundreds of megabytes of snapshots.

fixed.title: Animatics removed
fixed.description: The timeline, audio, time remap and Premiere/After Effects export are gone — a second app had grown inside a moodboard app. Boards saved by 2.0.6 still open, but any audio and video they held is skipped.

fixed.title: Content-aware fill removed
fixed.description: The lasso fill tool is no longer in the toolbar. It was too heavy and unreliable for everyday moodboard work.

fixed.title: Groups keep their contents
fixed.description: Arrow-keying a selected group moved the frame and left the images behind, and resizing one dropped them too. Both now move what they contain, and a nudge can be undone.

fixed.title: Group selection frame rotates with the images
fixed.description: The multi-select box stayed axis-aligned during a rotate, so it swelled and shrank under itself and the corner handles slid away from the pointer.

fixed.title: Copied images keep their original bytes
fixed.description: Copying an image to the clipboard re-encoded it. It now hands over the original file data.
